verdict.rationale: DBOS ships a first-party integration for the OpenAI Agents SDK (DBOSRunner as a drop-in replacement) plus dedicated AI-workload docs covering resilience, human-in-the-loop waits, durable streaming, and debugging/forking for agents, giving genuine glue-code-free durability for at least one popular agent framework. However, the evidence only shows one named framework integration (OpenAI Agents) — no first-party wrappers for other AI SDKs (e.g. LangChain, Vercel AI SDK) or multiple model providers are documented. Missing for 10: integrations with additional agent frameworks/AI SDKs beyond OpenAI Agents, explicit multi-model-provider wrappers, and independent/community confirmation of these AI-specific integrations working in practice.
